positions.title: Chief Executive Officer
positions.start_date_basis: 2002 IPO prospectus bio: CEO 'since September 1998'
positions.notes: Co-founder (1997) and Chairman since inception; Marc Randolph was CEO August 1997 to September 1998. Later proxies date the CEO role from 1997 (2023) or 1999 (2024-2026); see conflicts. Became co-CEO when Sarandos' co-CEO appointment took effect on 2020-07-14 (his Form 4 title changes from 'CEO' to 'Co-CEO' between the 2020-07-21 and 2020-08-03 reports).

positions.title: Co-Chief Executive Officer
positions.start_date_basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (2020-07-16): Sarandos named co-CEO with Hastings, 'effective as of July 14, 2020'
positions.notes: Co-CEO with Sarandos. Resigned as co-CEO and President on 2023-01-13 on becoming Executive Chairman.

positions.title: President
positions.start_date_basis: 2002 IPO prospectus bio: President 'since July 1999'
positions.notes: Randolph was President October 1998 to July 1999. The 2023 proxy says 'President (1997-January 2023)' and the 2024-2026 proxies '(1999-January 2023)'; the prospectus month is used. Peters (and Sarandos) took the President title in January 2023.

positions.title: Executive Chairman
positions.start_date_basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (2023-01-19): appointed Executive Chairman on January 13, 2023, 'effective immediately'
positions.notes: Remained an employee and a Rule 3b-7 executive officer as Executive Chairman. From 2025-04-17 non-executive Chairman and no longer an employee; left the board at the 2026-06-04 annual meeting (board file).

positions.title: Chief Content Officer
positions.start_date_basis: Form 3 date of event 2007-03-14 (officer title 'Chief Content Officer'); no 8-K
positions.notes: Has run content since March 2000 (VP of Content Acquisition; bios later say Chief Content Officer 'since 2000'), but the 2002 prospectus lists him as a key employee and the 2006 proxy's executive-officer list omits him. His first Form 3 (event 2007-03-14, the same day as Forms 3 for the Chief Product and Chief Talent Officers) marks his designation; the 2008 proxy lists him as an executive officer. Kept the CCO title as co-CEO until January 2023 (day not stated).

positions.title: Co-Chief Executive Officer
positions.start_date_basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (2020-07-16): appointed co-CEO on July 13, 2020, 'effective as of July 14, 2020'
positions.notes: Co-CEO with Hastings to 2023-01-13, then with Peters. Joined the board the same day (board file). Current in the 2026 proxy and his 2026-08-04 Form 4; no later Item 5.02 change through 2026-10-02.

positions.title: President
positions.start_date_basis: 2023 proxy roster: 'co-Chief Executive Officer and President' after the January 2023 transitions (2022 roster: 'Co-Chief Executive Officer and Chief Content Officer')
positions.notes: No filing states the day; Hastings gave up the President title and Peters was made co-CEO and President on 2023-01-13, so that day is likely. Current per the 2026 proxy; no later Item 5.02 change through 2026-10-02.

positions.title: Chief Streaming and Partnerships Officer
positions.start_date_basis: Form 3 date of event 2013-07-30 (officer title 'Chf Platform/Partnership Ofcr'); 2014 proxy: 'since July 2013'
positions.notes: Joined Netflix in 2008 (VP, Engineering from October 2008; not an executive officer, absent from the 2013 proxy roster). The move to International Development Officer is dated only by his Form 4 officer titles: streaming/partnerships on the report filed 2015-03-04, International Development Officer on the one filed 2015-04-03.

positions.title: International Development Officer
positions.start_date_basis: Form 4 officer title changes between the reports filed 2015-03-04 and 2015-04-03; 2015 proxy roster (2015-04-27) lists the new title
positions.notes: Ended when he succeeded Neil Hunt as Chief Product Officer in July 2017.

positions.title: Chief Product Officer
positions.start_date_basis: 2019 proxy bio: 'assumed the role of Chief Product Officer in July 2017'; predecessor resigned effective 2017-06-23 (8-K)
positions.notes: Bios: CPO '2017-January 2023'. Ended on his 2023-01-13 promotion to co-CEO and President.

positions.title: Chief Operating Officer

positions.notes: Held together with Chief Product Officer. Bios: COO 'July 2020-January 2023'.

positions.title: Chief Financial Officer
positions.start_date_basis: 8-K Item 5.02 (2010-12-07): appointed CFO succeeding McCarthy, whose resignation was effective December 10, 2010; Form 3 event date 2010-12-10
positions.notes: Previously VP of Financial Planning & Analysis (not an executive officer). Announced 2018-08-13 that he would resign once a successor was appointed; stopped acting as CFO on 2019-01-07 (Neumann's start) and left the company 2019-01-18 with a $4,500,000 Severance Plan payment.

positions.title: Chief Marketing Officer
positions.start_date_basis: Form 3 date of event 2012-08-06 (officer title 'Chief Marketing Officer'); 2013 proxy: CMO 'since July 2012'; no 8-K
positions.notes: External hire from Warner Bros. The bio month (July 2012) is a few days earlier than the Section 16 date used here (see conflicts). Resignation announced 2019-03-07, pending a replacement; still on the 2019-04-23 roster. No filing gives a separate end date for the CMO role, so the 2019-06-30 employment end is used; $5,250,000 Severance Plan payment.

positions.title: General Counsel and Secretary
positions.start_date_basis: Form 3 date of event 2010-12-10 (officer title 'General Counsel'); first on a proxy executive-officer roster in 2011 ('General Counsel and Secretary')
positions.notes: General Counsel since February 2002, but a key employee (not an executive officer) in the 2002 prospectus and absent from the 2010 proxy roster. Bios from 2020 say 'Chief Legal Officer and Secretary of Netflix (since 2002)', folding in the pre-officer years. Secretary start not stated (McCarthy was Secretary until June 2007). The title became Chief Legal Officer between the 2019-12-23 8-K (signed 'General Counsel') and the 2020-04-22 proxy roster; year precision.

positions.title: Chief Legal Officer and Secretary
positions.start_date_basis: 2020 proxy roster (2020-04-22): 'Chief Legal Officer and Secretary'; the 2019-12-23 8-K was still signed 'General Counsel'
positions.notes: Same role renamed; start is somewhere in 2019-12-23 to 2020-04-22. Current per the 2026 proxy and the 2026-07-30 8-K signature; no later Item 5.02 change through 2026-10-02.

positions.title: Chief Communications Officer

conflicts.description: Hastings' FY2020 Option Awards in the 2023 proxy SCT is printed '42,428,87' (a digit is missing; the raw HTML cell has the same text). The 2021 and 2022 proxies print 42,428,878, and all three print the same total (43,226,024 = 650,000 + 42,428,878 + 147,146). The 2023-proxy row is kept as filed: the unreadable cell is recorded as 0, so its components sum to 797,146 and verify reports a WARN. Note this is the latest filing for FY2020, so a 'latest filing' view shows 0 option awards for that year even though the total is right.

Start of Hastings' CEO and President roles. The 2002 IPO prospectus says CEO 'since September 1998' and President 'since July 1999' (Randolph was CEO August 1997 to September 1998 and President October 1998 to July 1999). The 2023 proxy says 'co-Chief Executive Officer, President (1997-January 2023)'; the 2024-2026 proxies say 'Chief Executive Officer, President (1999-January 2023)'. The contemporaneous prospectus months are used (medium confidence), matching the board file.

Bios date Sarandos' Chief Content Officer role to 2000 and Hyman's legal role to 2002 ('Chief Legal Officer and Secretary of Netflix (since 2002)'), but neither was an executive officer then: the 2002 prospectus lists both as key employees, the 2006 proxy roster omits Sarandos and the 2010 roster omits Hyman. Their executive-officer tenures start at their Form 3 event dates (2007-03-14 and 2010-12-10); the earlier years are in notes only.

Bennett's start as Chief Marketing Officer: the 2013 proxy says 'since July 2012' while his Form 3 gives 2012-08-06 as the date he became a Section 16 officer (no 8-K). The Form 3 date is used; the title may be a few days older.

Hyman's title: the 2019-12-23 8-K is signed 'General Counsel' and his Form 4s keep the 'General Counsel' officer title into mid-2020, but the 2020-04-22 proxy already lists him as 'Chief Legal Officer and Secretary' and the SCT there calls him Chief Legal Officer for 2017-2019 too. The rename is recorded at year precision (2020).

PvP TSR restated by rebasing. The 2023-2025 proxies measure from 2019-12-31 (2020 = 167.11, 2021 = 186.19, 2022 = 91.13, 2023 = 150.47, 2024 = 275.46); the 2026 proxy's table starts at 2021 and measures from 2020-12-31, so the same years read 111.41, 54.53, 90.04 and 164.84 (peer index likewise). Both match NFLX year-end closes on their own base. Recorded as filed.

PvP net income units: the 2023 proxy prints net income in $ thousands (2022: 4,491,924; 2021: 5,116,228; 2020: 2,761,395), later proxies in $ millions (4,492; 5,116; 2,761). Recorded as filed, so net_income_usd for the same year differs by rounding between filings.

Sarandos' President start and Chief Content Officer end are dated only 'January 2023'. Hastings gave up President and Peters became co-CEO and President on 2023-01-13, so that day is likely for both; no filing says so. His Chief Content Officer successor is not named in the filings reviewed.

coverage.method: Summary Compensation Tables from all eight definitive proxies filed 2019-2026 (DEF 14A each year; no DEFC14A or DEFR14A in the period). One comp row per (filing, NEO, fiscal year). FY2016 comes only from the 2019 proxy and FY2017 from the 2019 and 2020 proxies (earlier proxies are outside scope). Column layouts change almost every year (Bonus, Non-Equity Incentive and Stock Awards columns come and go); each row's notes give that filing's columns. No Netflix SCT has a Pension/NQDC column. Checked with no SCT: the 2019-02-08 10-K/A (exhibit-only amendment), every DEFA14A (2019-2026, including the 2022-05-23 proxy supplement) and the 2026 DFAN14A. The 2022 PRE 14A SCT matches the DEF 14A line for line and is not recorded separately.

Every PvP table (2023-2026 DEF 14A). One row per (filing, fiscal year), with each PEO's SCT total and CAP captured separately: Hastings and Sarandos for 2020-2022, Hastings, Sarandos and Peters for 2023, Sarandos and Peters for 2024-2025.

For every NEO: 2002 IPO prospectus roster and bios, proxy executive-officer rosters (2006, 2008, 2010, 2011, 2013-2015, 2019-2026), every 8-K with Item 5.02 in the EDGAR submissions feed from 2017 through 2026-10-02 (plus the 2010 CFO 8-K), each NEO's Form 3 and Form 4 officer titles at transitions. Day precision comes from 8-K effective dates, proxy statements of effective dates, or Form 3 event dates; title changes without a dated filing are month or year precision. Non-officer periods (Sarandos and Hyman before their Form 3s, Whetstone and Ezama after 2023-01-13, Hastings as non-executive Chairman) are in notes only.
Pre-2019 officer history only for people who are NEOs in a 2019-2026 proxy; earlier executives (McCarthy, Kilgore, Hunt, McCord, Cranz, Neal and others) and pre-officer roles are not covered.
